title: Unirational algebraic groups and tame ramification
summary: Let $\mathcal{O}_K$ be a complete discrete valuation ring with field of fractions $K$ and algebraically closed residue field $k.$ Let $G$ be a smooth connected commutative algebraic group over $K$ which does not contain a copy of $\mathbf{G}_{\mathrm{a}}.$ For each $d$ prime to $p:=\mathrm{char}\, k,$ let $K(d)$ be the unique extension of $K$ of degree $d.$ We investigate how the Néron lft-model of $G$ behaves under base change to the ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_{K(d)}.$ Information about this behaviour is encoded in the "jumps" of Edixhoven's filtration on the special fibre of the Néron…
